items.title: Ford and GM Attempts to Go Beyond Cars Deserve Skepticism
items.summary: Ford Motor  and  General Motors  are looking beyond cars.  In May, Ford’s shares surged as much as 45%, adding nearly $23 billion of market value, in the weeks after it formally announced Ford Energy, a grid-scale battery-storage business that will serve the power needs of artificial-intelligence hyperscalers and utilities.  Its shares have since moderated, but are still up more than 20% since the Ford Energy launch.
